{{Top|leg}}
'''Rathleek''' was a [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[spearmaster]] of a [[Rathleek's hunting band|hunting band]]].

Some years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] he led a band of 21 [[hunting/Legends|hunters]] to the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], whose single continent was mostly covered by an immense virgin and undeveloped jungle, the [[Arblis Forest]]. They settled at an [[Abandoned smelting plant]], west of the outskirts of the jungle.

The whiphid hunters enjoyed hunting [[Millitile/Legends|millitiles]] in the forest and [[Ganjuko]]s near the ice caps. The made profit by trading millitile legs to the Bothans, but also being hired for hunting expeditions or as guides. They had been employed by [[Consul-General]] [[Gilad Halsek]] a few times, and elite Bothans enjoyed hunting expeditions with them.
